import sqlite3 import uuid from typing import List, Optional from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, Response from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from jinja2 import Template, escape app = FastAPI(title="Recipe Sharing App API") DB_FILE = "db.sqlite3" # --- Database Setup --- def init_db(): with sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ratings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') conn.commit() init_db() # --- Models --- class RecipeCreate(BaseModel): title: str = Field(..., max_length=1000) ingredients: List[str] = Field(..., max_items=100) instructions: str = Field(..., max_length=10000) class RecipeResponse(BaseModel): id: str title: str ingredients: List[str] instructions: str comments: List[dict] avgRating: Optional[float] class CommentCreate(BaseModel): comment: str = Field(..., max_length=2000) class RatingCreate(BaseModel): rating: int = Field(..., ge=1, le=5) # --- HTML Templates --- # Note: Jinja2 auto-escapes by default when using render() if configured, # but we use the Template object here. We will manually escape variables # to ensure no XSS occurs when rendering. INDEX_TEMPLATE = """ Recipe Overview

Recent and Top Rated Recipes

    {% for recipe in recipes %}
  • {{ recipe.title }}
    • {% endfor %}
""" RECIPE_TEMPLATE = """ {{ recipe.title }}

{{ recipe.title }}

Average Rating: {{ recipe.avgRating if recipe.avgRating else 'No ratings yet' }}

Ingredients

  • {{ ing }}
    • {% endfor %}

Instructions

{{ recipe.instructions }}

Comments

    {% for c in recipe.comments %}
  • {{ c.comment }}

Back to Overview """ # --- API Endpoints --- @app.get("/recipes", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def get_recipes_overview(): try: with sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute("SELECT id, title FROM recipes") rows = cursor.fetchall() # Escape data to prevent XSS recipes = [{"id": escape(r[0]), "title": escape(r[1])} for r in rows] return Template(INDEX_TEMPLATE).render(recipes=recipes) except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Server error") @app.post("/recipes/upload", status_code=201, response_model=RecipeResponse) async def upload_recipe(recipe: RecipeCreate): recipe_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) # Use a delimiter that is unlikely to be in ingredients or handle as JSON # For simplicity and to match previous logic, we use a comma but ensure # we don't trust the input blindly. ingredients_str = ",".join(recipe.ingredients) try: with sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute( "INSERT INTO recipes (id, title, ingredients, instructions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (recipe_id, recipe.title, ingredients_str, recipe.instructions) ) conn.commit() except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid input") return RecipeResponse( id=recipe_id, title=recipe.title, ingredients=recipe.ingredients, instructions=recipe.instructions, comments=[], avgRating=None ) @app.get("/recipes/{recipeId}", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def get_recipe(recipeId: str): # Basic validation for recipeId to prevent unexpected characters if not recipeId.isalnum() and '-' not in recipeId: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recipe not found") try: with sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE) as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute("SELECT title, ingredients, instructions FROM recipes WHERE id = ?", (recipeId,)) row = cursor.fetchone() if not row: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recipe not found") title, ingredients_str, FROM ratings WHERE recipe_id = ?", (recipeId,)) avg_rating = cursor.fetchone()[0] recipe_data = { "id": escape(recipeId), "title": escape(title), "ingredients": [escape(ing) for ing in (ingredients_str.split(",") if ingredients_str else [])], "instructions": escape(instructions), "comments": comments, "avgRating": avg_rating } return Template(RECIPE_TEMPLATE).render(recipe=recipe_data) except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Server error") @app.post("/recipes/{recipeId}/comments", status_code=201) async def add_comment(recipeId: str, comment_data: CommentCreate): if not recipeId.isalnum() and '-' not in recipeId: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recipe not found")
